news.label: IBM unveils the Personal Computer
points: Unveiled August 12, 1981, at New York’s Waldorf Hotel
From USD 1,565; 16 KB RAM and no disk drive
Open design supports software and peripheral development

lines.say: Breaking from New York, August twelfth, nineteen eighty-one: I B M has just unveiled its Personal Computer at the Waldorf Hotel.
lines.show: Breaking from New York, August 12, 1981: IBM has just unveiled its Personal Computer at the Waldorf Hotel.

lines.say: The price starts at one thousand five hundred sixty-five dollars, with sixteen kilobytes of RAM and no disk drive.
lines.show: The price starts at USD 1,565, with 16 KB of RAM and no disk drive.

lines.say: The design is open. I B M is publishing circuit details and source code for software and peripheral developers.
lines.show: The design is open. IBM is publishing circuit details and source code for software and peripheral developers.

news.label: Commodore 64 debuts at Winter CES
points: Introduced at Winter CES in Las Vegas, January 1982
Graphics and sound chips designed and prototyped in-house

lines.say: Next stop, Las Vegas, January nineteen eighty-two. Commodore is introducing the Commodore sixty-four at the Winter Consumer Electronics Show.
lines.show: Next stop, Las Vegas, January 1982. Commodore is introducing the Commodore 64 at the Winter Consumer Electronics Show.

lines.say: For five hundred ninety-five dollars, the package includes sixty-four kilobytes of memory, a keyboard, processor, graphics, and sound.
lines.show: For USD 595, the package includes 64 KB of memory, a keyboard, processor, graphics, and sound.

lines.say: The graphics and sound chips were designed in-house at Commodore's M O S Technology subsidiary, using its own chip fabrication facilities.
lines.show: The graphics and sound chips were designed in-house at Commodore's MOS Technology subsidiary, using its own chip fabrication facilities.

closing.say: That's The Morning Modem. We sign on weekly at seven A M, Chicago time.
closing.show: That's The Morning Modem. We sign on weekly at 07:00 America/Chicago.
